name: Naieem Baloch
role: Rehman Dakait's eldest son — succession heir
real_life_inspiration: Rehman Dakait's real eldest son. After Rehman's 2009 death, the PAC fragmented between Uzair Baloch and other family/gang figures. Naieem represents the blood-succession claim to the Dakait criminal empire.

inspiration_notes.succession_context: Rehman Dakait did have sons. After his death, the Lyari criminal landscape fragmented significantly — Uzair Baloch took operational control but the Dakait family's symbolic authority remained. Naieem's role in Film 2 is likely navigating this post-Dakait inheritance.
inspiration_notes.film2_relevance: As Film 2 deals with the post-Dakait power vacuum and Uzair Baloch's succession, Naieem represents the tension between family blood claim and operational control. He is a potential Shapley high-value swing vote — his allegiance (to Uzair, to ISI, or to the Khanani network) significantly affects coalition stability.
